newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATHLETIC BILBAO TAKE SPAIN'S LAST UEFA PLACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATHLETIC BILBAO TAKE SPAIN'S LAST UEFA PLACE.

text.p: Athletic Bilbao booked Spain's last UEFA Cup place on Monday with a hard-fought 1-0 first division victory over Deportivo Coruna.
A 68th minute strike from international midfielder Julen Guerrero was enough to take the three points, and deny Athletic's Basque rivals Real Sociedad a place in Europe
Athletic will join Valladolid, Deportivo and Atletico Madrid in the UEFA Cup. Newly-crowned champions Real Madrid, and Barcelona, will play the European Cup and Real Betis the Cup Winners' Cup.
